description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git apply' command under various conditions, including error cases with unrecognized input, no-op patches, and invalid combinations of options. It defines test cases and uses shell functions for assertions.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates an initial commit in the test repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case with a description and a block of commands that should succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes commands expecting them to fail.
